name: City of College Park Downtown Parking Garage
address: 4509 Knox Road, College Park, MD 20740 (at the corner of Knox Road and Yale Avenue)
operator: City of College Park (Department of Public Services)
pricing_summary: $2.00/hour, Mon-Sat 8:00am-10:00pm, payable only by credit card or mobile app at electronic pay stations (per collegeparkmd.gov/parking, checked Aug 2026). Vehicles with handicap tags park free all day (no overnight parking permitted). Note: a couple of third-party aggregator sites (e.g. Yelp) list an older $0.75/hour rate - treat the official city site as authoritative and verify at the pay station.
hours_summary: Enforced Monday-Saturday, 8:00am-10:00pm, except City-observed holidays; appears unenforced/free outside those hours and on Sundays per the official rate structure.
source: collegeparkmd.gov/parking (official City of College Park page, fetched directly) + OpenStreetMap Nominatim named match 'City of College Park Downtown Parking Garage' at 4509 Knox Road
note: In the heart of Downtown College Park, about 0.5 miles / ~10 min walk south of the main campus core, near Route 1 (Baltimore Ave) restaurants/shops. Has 2 EV charging stations. Some secondary listings (Yelp, an older Parkopedia entry) give the address as '7306 Yale Ave' instead of the Knox Road address OSM lists - likely reflects the building's dual street frontage at the Knox/Yale corner rather than a factual conflict, but flagging for a human to double-check the exact posted street number if it matters for the app.

name: Cambria College Park Garage
address: 8321 Baltimore Avenue, College Park, MD 20740 (alley entrance)
operator: Cambria Hotel College Park (Choice Hotels franchisee; privately operated, not UMD)
pricing_summary: Reported around $10-12 per night: ParkWhiz lists it as a bookable garage at this address for about $10, while the hotel's own guest-parking rate is described in press/review sources as $12.00/vehicle/night with in-and-out privileges. Treat as approximate; not independently confirmed from the hotel's own published rate card, so pricing_summary should be read as 'roughly $10-12/night, confirm current rate with the hotel.'
hours_summary: Not confirmed (self-park garage typically accessible whenever the hotel is staffed; no published public hours found).
source: ParkWhiz listing ('Cambria College Park Garage, 8321 Baltimore Ave. Alley Entrance') + choicehotels.com/cambriacollegepark.com hotel site + OpenStreetMap Nominatim named match 'Cambria' hotel building at 8321 Baltimore Avenue
note: About 1.1 miles / ~20-22 min walk north of the main campus core, in the Lakeland/Discovery District area of Baltimore Avenue near Ritchie Coliseum's north side - at the outer edge of the 'walkable' range for most students, more realistic for visitors driving up and walking the last stretch, or biking/scooting in. Bookable via third-party parking apps (ParkWhiz/SpotHero-style aggregators), which is a meaningfully different access model than the WMATA or City garages (no dedicated public pay station on-site; you generally reserve ahead through an app or ask the hotel directly).
